name: Guild Style
short:
A well-balanced style that
allows for 2 Hunter Arts and
a variety of weapon attacks.
full:
Guild Style is the definitive style for
members of the Hunter's Guild.
<COL FF0000FF>Allows for two Hunter Arts</COL> and
has a versatile mix of attacks. Great
for <COL FF0000FF>adapting to any situation</COL>.
sp:
Entering the SP State in Guild Style
will <COL FF0000FF>speed up your item usage</COL>,
allowing you to lay traps and
heal yourself quickly.

name: Striker Style
short:
Relatively simple to use, and
allows up to 3 Hunter Arts.
Arts Gauge fills quickly.
full:
Striker Style is a relatively simple-to-use
Style that lets you equip <COL FF0000FF>up to three
Hunter Arts</COL>. It's also <COL FF0000FF>easier to charge
up the Arts Gauge</COL>, so this style is
perfect for going heavy on the Arts.
sp:
Entering the SP State in Striker Style
will cause your Arts Gauge to <COL FF0000FF>gradually
fill by itself over time</COL> even while you're
not attacking, helping it <COL FF0000FF>fill more quickly</COL>.

name: Aerial Style
short:
Perform an Aerial Dodge to launch
yourself off of monsters and
other players for a jump attack.
full:
Aerial Style is unique for allowing you
to use an Aerial Dodge to <COL FF0000FF>jump on monsters
and propel yourself high into the air</COL>.
You can also launch yourself off of players
and barrels. Great for <COL FF0000FF>mounting monsters</COL>.
sp:
Entering the SP State in Aerial Style
will empower your legs, giving you
<COL FF0000FF>quicker recovery of Stamina lost</COL>
while performing a Boost Jump.

name: Adept Style
short:
Allows you to perform Insta-
Moves by dodging or blocking
just before an attack connects.
full:
Adept Style is all about waiting until
the last second to evade or guard your
foe's attacks, letting you perform <COL FF0000FF>Insta-
Moves</COL>. It's difficult to pull off, but
allows for <COL FF0000FF>devastating counterattacks</COL>.
sp:
Entering the SP State in Adept Style
will allow you to perceive monsters'
habits, giving you <COL FF0000FF>an extended period
to carry out Insta-Moves</COL>.

name: Alchemy Style
short:
Uses the support-oriented
Alchemy Barrel to create items
and power up your SP State.
full:
Alchemy Style is <COL FF0000FF>ideal for support</COL>. In
addition to equipping <COL FF0000FF>up to 3 Hunter Arts
or SP Hunter Arts</COL>, you can also shake a
special <COL FF0000FF>Alchemy Barrel</COL> to create Alchemy
Items, power up your SP State, and more.
sp:
Entering the SP State in Alchemy
Style will cause the <COL FF0000FF>Alchemy Gauge
to fill more quickly</COL>, allowing you to
use your Alchemy Barrel more often.

name: Valor Style
short:
Relies on Sheathing to
fill Gauge and unlock
powerful skills.
full:
Valor Style relies on Sheathing to <COL FF0000FF>fill
your Gauge and enter a stronger,
faster Valor State</COL>. Fill your Gauge by
<COL FF0000FF>using sheathe canceling attacks</COL> and
avoiding attacks with a <COL FF0000FF>sheathing stance</COL>.
sp:
Entering the SP State in Valor Style
will cause the <COL FF0000FF>Valor Gauge to fill
more quickly</COL>, giving you more
chances to enter the Valor State.
